summary.key_theme: Nvidia 憑藉強勁的 AI 基礎設施需求、龐大的投資組合價值以及持續擴張的全球算力版圖，維持了市場對其長期成長的高度信心。

bullish.title: Central Bank of AI: Analyst Says NVIDIA Could Sit on $1.4 Trillion — Dwarfing Hyperscalers and Wall Street
bullish.reason: 研究機構 SemiAnalysis 指出 Nvidia 可能累積高達 1.4 兆美元的現金儲備，顯示其在 AI 算力供應鏈中的壟斷地位與驚人的獲利能力。

bullish.title: Anthropic Locks Down $517 Billion in Compute Ahead of IPO — and It’s Still Not Enough
bullish.reason: Anthropic 簽署巨額算力合約，進一步驗證了市場對 Nvidia 高階 GPU 的剛性需求，直接支撐了華爾街對其營收的樂觀預測。

bullish.title: Nvidia May Put $10 Billion Into Anthropic’s $2 Trillion IPO. Amazon Already Has Much More Riding on It
bullish.reason: Nvidia 擬投資 100 億美元參與 Anthropic 的 IPO，顯示公司正積極透過資本運作深化 AI 生態系布局。

bullish.title: Nvidia (NVDA)’s 2 GW Australia AI Push Could Deepen Its Infrastructure Advantage
bullish.reason: Nvidia 在澳洲推動 2 GW 的 AI 基礎設施計畫，展現其在全球市場持續擴張算力版圖的執行力。

bullish.title: Oracle's AI Chips Ran 97.9% Utilized Last Quarter. For Nvidia, That Is What a Shortage Looks Like.
bullish.reason: Oracle 的 GPU 利用率高達 97.9%，反映出市場對 Nvidia 產品的極度供不應求，即便舊款晶片仍具備高度租賃價值。

bullish.title: Nvidia (NVDA) Looks Cheap on Piper’s Forecasts, but the Earnings Assumptions Are the Real Test
bullish.reason: Piper Sandler 分析指出 Nvidia 目前估值相對便宜，儘管市場對其未來財報假設仍有嚴格檢視，但基本面支撐強勁。

bullish.title: Here Are the Companies in Nvidia's $99 Billion Artificial Intelligence (AI) Portfolio. These 3 Are the Best of the Bunch
bullish.reason: Nvidia 持有價值 990 億美元的投資組合，為公司提供了額外的資產價值與戰略協同效應。

bullish.title: If I Could Only Buy 1 Artificial Intelligence (AI) Stock, This Would Be It
bullish.reason: 市場普遍將 Nvidia 視為 AI 領域的首選標的，強化了投資人的持股信心。

bearish.title: Nvidia's Latest Signal Points to Serious Downside Risk for Micron Before 2029 Is Over
bearish.reason: 雖然此文主要針對 Micron，但提及 Nvidia 推動使用更便宜的記憶體，暗示未來可能對供應鏈議價能力產生影響，對 Nvidia 而言屬潛在的供應鏈變數。

bearish.title: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang doubles down on his big 2030 market bet
bearish.reason: 執行長黃仁勳的長期大膽押注雖具願景，但市場對其 2030 年目標的可實現性仍存有疑問，可能引發部分投資人的擔憂。

neutral.title: Nvidia vs. Broadcom: Which Trillion-Dollar AI Chip Stock Has More Upside After Their Latest Earnings?
neutral.reason: 將 Nvidia 與 Broadcom 進行比較，屬於中性的產業分析，兩者皆表現強勁，無明顯利多或利空。

neutral.title: Nvidia Gets the AI Hype. Dell Gets the Billionaire Fortune
neutral.reason: 報導 Michael Dell 的財富增長，僅是市場花邊新聞，對 Nvidia 本身股價無直接影響。

neutral.title: Shiba Inu vs. Nvidia: Which Is More Likely to Win Over the Next 5 Years?
neutral.reason: 將加密貨幣與科技巨頭進行比較，屬於投機性觀點，對基本面分析參考價值有限。

neutral.title: Why Retail Traders Couldn’t Take Their Eyes Off These Stocks Last Week
neutral.reason: 僅提及散戶關注度，屬於市場情緒觀察，未提供具體財務影響。
